3777.title: Preserve a diagram during failed replacement
3777.rootCauseOneLine: Reused render IDs let Mermaid remove the visible SVG, and the rejection handler discards successful preview state.
3777.proposedFix: Use a distinct ID per actual render and retain successful state on rejection.
3777.caveats: Second run uses a component regression; real-browser reproduction was in the first checkout only.
